summary: semantic_assertion binding basis (cinatra#1426, epic #1424). Adds the assertion_basis discriminant ('binding' | 'classic', NOT NULL, existing rows backfilled 'classic' via the column DEFAULT — metadata-only) plus the binding anchor pair binding_claim_id (the artifact_type_claims row the binding was written under; plain text, never an FK) and binding_generation (its claim-activation generation) — both NULL for classic. Transition safety: the effective-identity service ignores a binding whose (claim row, generation) pair is no longer the current winner's; generations are per-claim counters restarting at 1, so the claim-row anchor is what stops a retired claim's binding revalidating against a new same-package claim. Constraint-backed guards: sa_one_active_binding_idx — ONE ACTIVE binding per artifact across all extensions (partial unique on (org_id, artifact_id) WHERE assertion_basis='binding' AND eligibility <> 'archived', so a second concurrent binding insert rejects at the DB); sa_basis_chk (vocabulary, mirrored by ASSERTION_BASES in @cinatra-ai/objects/effective-identity); sa_binding_generation_chk + sa_binding_claim_chk (a binding always carries its generation + claim row, a classic row never does); sa_binding_never_matcher_chk (matcher drafts never produce bindings). Replaces fn_semantic_assertion_frozen to also freeze assertion_basis + binding_claim_id + binding_generation (binding mutations are the defined reconciliations, each a new INSERT — append-only doctrine). Adds sa_extension_artifact_idx, the (org, extension, artifact) lookup index for per-extension identity scans. Gate class destructive (NOT-NULL column on an existing user-data table + a unique index on it) though operationally safe: the NOT NULL rides a DEFAULT (metadata-only on PG11+, every existing row reads 'classic') and the partial unique index matches zero existing rows (no 'binding' rows exist before cinatra#1429 writes the first one — it cannot fail on existing duplicates). Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries (fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade aligned, core__0034 precedent). down() restores the pre-0036 trigger body first, then drops the indexes/constraints/columns; binding rows written after up() lose their discriminant on --down (accepted operator cost at this slice).
